modules: Single Maven module com.apexledger.banking (Java 21, Spring Boot 3); package per bounded context
shared: Money, DomainEvent, DomainRuleViolationException, EventPublisher, SpringEventPublisher, BankingConfiguration

Context-to-units: Account Lifecycle -> AccountEvents, AccountState, Hold, DepositAccount, AccountRepository, CustomerVerificationPort, LedgerBalancePort, AccountService, InMemoryAccountRepository, ConfigurableCustomerVerificationAdapter, AccountController
layers: domain: DepositAccount aggregate, Hold, AccountState, AccountEvents; no framework imports
application: AccountService use cases; outbound ports AccountRepository, CustomerVerificationPort, LedgerBalancePort in application.port
infrastructure: in-memory repository and customer verification adapter (customer/KYC context is outside scope)
interface (package api): thin AccountController with DTOs and ProblemDetail mapping
shared: cross-cutting kernel only; no context imports another context's domain or application
build_order: Shared kernel: Money, DomainRuleViolationException, DomainEvent, EventPublisher, SpringEventPublisher, BankingConfiguration
Accounts domain: AccountEvents, AccountState, Hold, DepositAccount
Accounts ports then AccountService, then infrastructure adapters, then AccountController
